title: Drinking water potability prediction using machine learning approaches: a case study of Indian rivers
abstract: Research on predicting water potability using ML techniques for Indian rivers.

title: Applications of Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence in Metal Die Casting
abstract: Presented research on AI/ML applications in manufacturing processes.

title: Contrastive Fine-Tuning of SapBERT for Biomedical Entity Linking over Large-Scale Ontologies
abstract: Fine-tuned SapBERT via contrastive training on newer ontologies and built an entity linking module over a 6M+ entity FAISS index, achieving 0.675 Recall@1 and 0.736 MRR.

title: A Biomedical Knowledge Graph for Harmonized Literature Ingestion and Relationship Discovery
abstract: Designed a biomedical knowledge graph ingesting PubMed literature via REST APIs, with entity harmonization and bulk Neo4j loading, unifying data across 18+ relationship types.
